purpose: User-requested top-5/top-20 comparison (top 20 substituted for top 15 by user) and THINK+mixer pseudo-Huber loss extension
universe: Same reconstructed official historical monthly Nasdaq-100 fallback and corporate-action inputs
optimizer: AdamW, weight decay 0.001, gradient norm cap 1, FP32 deterministic CUDA, no AMP/TF32
validation: Same purged prior-year MSE early stopping as frozen MSE and Huber fits; no return-based selection
allocation: Equal long-only targets; approximately 20%, 10%, 5% per selected security; same ties, next-close frozen orders, costs and liquidity caps
individual_seed_portfolios: Every neural seed at each of the three sizes with base costs, plus all-five-seed rank ensemble
comparisons: Reuse parent frozen predictions and all matching top-5/top-10/top-20 ensemble paths; add individual seed checks at top 5 and 20; no refitting old models
controls: Same continuous SPY, QQQ and monthly equal basket; their policies do not change with K
stop_rule: Complete and lock every one of 20 new fits before new financial test metrics. Report all sizes, seeds and cost scenarios; no best-K or delta tuning
limitations: 2022-2025 already inspected; this is an adaptive exploratory follow-up, not fresh confirmation. Parent data limitations remain. No top-15 test is needed after the user's substitution.
